# AGENTS.md — GitHub integration

DSHU does not ship GitHub Actions workflows. Follow the [delivery checklist](../.agents/TODO.md) and [desktop packaging guide](../apps/desktop/packaging/README.md) for local build and acceptance work. Keep issue and pull-request templates aligned with this fork.

Record the exact local checks and their results. An empty Actions run list is not a passing CI result. Restoring upstream publication or runner workflows is outside the rc.2 intake.

The [upstream instructions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2/.github/AGENTS.md) describe upstream runner routing, merge checks and publication policy; they do not establish active DSHU workflows.
